note: A named example that is a bare value is that example's value, and an examples map written as one `$ref` declares none; crozier now reads both where it failed to parse the document.

The certified pair ignores response links, so a Link Object `$ref` to an absent `components/links` entry refuses nothing; crozier no longer walks links (settled with crozier-refuses-component-link-ref, same rule).
An allOf body whose inline anyOf branches redeclare the $ref parent's properties sends each property once, inline members' first; crozier passed them twice, which ruff rejects.
A 3.1 boolean schema is dropped from an allOf (allOf [number, true] is float) and is a typing.Any member of a oneOf/anyOf; crozier now reads it where it failed to parse.
The certified pair ignores response links, so a Link Object `$ref` to a declared `components/links` entry refuses nothing; crozier no longer walks links (settled with R14, same rule).

A response written as a `$ref` to a component schema, not a response, is the certified pair's parse failure over the empty scaffold (exit 0), so crozier keeps refusing it as unresolved-reference in both modes.
An allOf extension of a nullable parent reached only through an object declaring additionalProperties: true is no example-missing-required-property to the certified pair; crozier now generates it.
The empty path key is a request to the base URL with no path argument, as the root path is; any other key without a leading slash stays refused.

A multipart-only component's nested inline types and a component its SDK group places in a tag's package are each one declaration, in the operation's or group's package; crozier no longer refuses them as type-name-collision.

A non-string `type` list entry (type: [string, false]) is one more union member the certified pair types typing.Any, hoisted as the property's union alias; crozier now reads it where it failed to parse.

A path parameter the template does not name is refused by the certified pair (exit 1, Path parameter is unreferenced), and crozier keeps refusing it as path-parameter-unreferenced in both modes; the record's document is refused by both for its missing info.

An info written as null (or absent) is the certified pair's parse failure over the empty scaffold, a refusal under the refusal rule and ruling empty-sdk-refused; crozier now refuses it as missing-info-object in both modes.

A path parameter whose name a direct allOf parent's property declares is renamed id_path_param and the allOf body lowered, as the certified pair does; crozier refused the document and could not lower the body.

Two string-enum components whose names differ only in their first letter's case, the earlier's values among the later's, are one type with the later declaration's values; crozier no longer refuses them, and still refuses any other such pair.
A shelf[] query parameter beside shelf is the certified pair's request-property-camelcase-collision refusal (exit 1); crozier now refuses it in both modes where it wrote a call passing shelf twice.
